t: 奥斯曼帝国首次将领土永久割让给基督教列强.
te: For the first time, the Ottoman Empire permanently cedes territory to the Christian powers.
dz: 奥斯曼帝国首次将领土永久割让给基督教列强.
de: For the first time, the Ottoman Empire permanently cedes territory to the Christian powers.

dz: 第一届利奥波丁文凭由神圣罗马皇帝颁发,承认希腊天主教神职人员在特兰西瓦尼亚公国享有与罗马天主教神职人员同等的特权.
de: First Leopoldine Diploma is issued by the Holy Roman Emperor, recognizing the Greek Catholic clergy enjoyed the same privileges as Roman Catholic priests in the Principality of Transylvania.

t: Guru Gobind Singh在旁遮普邦Anandpur Sahib建立卡尔萨.
te: Guru Gobind Singh establishes the Khalsa in Anandpur Sahib, Punjab.
dz: Guru Gobind Singh在旁遮普邦Anandpur Sahib建立卡尔萨.
de: Guru Gobind Singh establishes the Khalsa in Anandpur Sahib, Punjab.

dz: 根据"纳克沙希历",锡克教正式被印度北部的古鲁·戈宾德·辛格(Guru Gobind Singh)称为"卡尔萨"(Khalsa)-"勇士-圣斯"的兄弟会.
de: The Sikh religion is formalised as the Khalsa – the brotherhood of Warrior-Saints – by Guru Gobind Singh in northern India, in accordance with the Nanakshahi calendar.
